setup_guide.introduction: Try the public example repository or choose a local source folder.

sample.title: xv6 example
sample.description: Explore the public xv6 RISC-V kernel, component relationships and function changes.
sample.expected_output: An interactive component and function evolution map, focused architecture review and cited next steps.

values.inputs.payload.goal: Explain xv6 component boundaries and critical call paths, show function development in the captured Git window, and recommend the most useful next decision with evidence and limitations.

real.introduction: Enter a public GitHub repository URL or choose a local source folder.

fields.label: OpenCode review model
fields.description: Choose the runtime model used for every review task. Muse choices require a registered model route.

fields.label: Decision to support
fields.description: Describe the architecture decision, important journey or failure scenario, and any constraints the review should prioritize.

fields.label: Repository URL
fields.description: Public GitHub repository root. Leave empty when using a local folder.

fields.label: Source folder
fields.description: Local source folder, staged for the worker.

fields.label: Review decisions
fields.description: Optional architecture-reviews.json exported from the dashboard. Decisions are bound to repository and evidence identity.

starter_questions: Show the component graph and explain the most important dependencies.
How did the most changed functions evolve in the captured Git window?
Which callers, components and tests should we inspect before changing a hotspot?

static_html.writes: web_ui.json handle; offline page renders retained real snapshot data
